_comment: Onboarding orders Clarke has adjudicated himself, so 226 approve may accept them even though the pre-acceptance completeness review finds gaps (scripts/charity-lane-completeness.ps1). Every accept through this list is recorded as result 'accepted-adjudicated' with its gap codes, and the same run must open the onboarding_accepted_gaps ticket (workflow 205) listing those gaps and the preview URL. Order ids and dates only: this repository is public, so no names, emails or other applicant details. An entry is added only by a PR merged on Clarke's own approval; 'decision' cites where he gave it. Adjudication never covers a fraud, sanctions or eligibility finding, which 232 decides before an order reaches approve.
